title: CodexForClaudeRuns

anyOf.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

description: accounts.codexForClaudeRuns: the Codex account whose directory Claude runs get as CODEX_HOME and CODEX_WORKER_HOME (#2169). Null for the one signed-in Codex account when the environment holds exactly one, none otherwise; an account id for that account while it is held and signed in, none otherwise; false for none. Given only while credentials are injected. Preset null.
